Design + Foodtalks⁠ Benedetta De Mennato / ⁠@bdm.art.studio . Banana Bread . Ingredients: . – 6 bananas – 1 lemon – 120 gr of sugar – 6 gr of yeast – Salt – 200 grams of flour – 1 teaspoon of cinnamon – 2 eggs – A pinch of baking soda – 120 grams of butter – Walnuts – Chocolate chips . Preparation: . Cut five bananas and mash them with a fork, adding the juice of one lemon. Mix the sugar, butter, eggs and bananas together. Gradually add the flour while continuing to mix. . Add the nuts and chocolate and finally salt, baking soda and cinnamon. Put the mixture in a long and narrow baking dish and insert the remaining banana and other chocolate chips. .
